scripts.dev:client: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @akai/client
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @akai/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @akai/client && npm run build -w @akai/server
scripts.check: npm run check:assets && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.test:online: npm run build:shared && vitest run apps/server/src/online.test.ts apps/server/src/google.test.ts
scripts.test:browser:online:preview: VITE_GAME_MODE=online npm run build && node scripts/smoke-online.mjs --preview
scripts.test:community: npm run build:shared && vitest run apps/server/src/community.test.ts
scripts.test:browser:community:preview: VITE_GAME_MODE=online npm run build && node scripts/smoke-community.mjs --preview
scripts.test:market: npm run build:shared && vitest run apps/server/src/market.test.ts
scripts.test:browser:market:preview: VITE_GAME_MODE=online npm run build && node scripts/smoke-market.mjs --preview
scripts.test:premium: npm run build:shared && vitest run apps/server/src/premium.test.ts apps/server/src/premium-providers.test.ts
scripts.test:browser:premium:preview: VITE_GAME_MODE=online npm run build && node scripts/smoke-premium.mjs --preview
